title: Watercolor "Beachside #7" 1848 E Co. Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Gulf Views- Beach Access- Pool Views & Exclusive Access- 75'' Smart TV In Living Rooms- Remodeled Bathrooms 2024- Located in the Gulf district of WaterColor- 3 Adult Bikes (4 Max Per HOA)- 2 Parking spaces- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, and an enhanced WaterColor Grill and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Talk about a Gulf side Paradise! "Beachside #7" is a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom WaterColor condo that sleeps 10. Guests will love the stunning views of the pool, dunes, and Gulf. A large balcony overlooks Beachside's exclusive pool and direct beach access, and a back porch opens immediately onto the pool area.The first floor has a second comfortable living room with a queen pulldown murphy bed, a queen sleeper sofa, comfortable chairs, and a 75" Smart TV. The guest bedroom off the living room has a king bed and a shared newly remodeled bathroom with a shower. Both rooms enjoy private access to the back porch and beautiful views of the large exclusive pool and towering dunes covered in native scrub oak. Two covered, reserved parking spaces are available right next to the first floor entrance.The views only improve on the second floor! Guests can see native dunes and sparkling blue Gulf waters from an open kitchen, dining, and living area with hardwood floors. An additional entry behind the kitchen opens to a covered walkway accessible by stairs or elevator. A newly furnished guest bedroom with a king bed and a shared newly renovated bathroom with a shower also has separate access to the walkway. The beautifully renovated and inviting kitchen has premium stainless-steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, marble countertops, and a breakfast bar looking out onto a new dining table with seating for 6. Local artwork depicting Western Lake and soothing shades of white and gray create a calming environment for family and friends in the living area. The second floor living room offers a 75'' Smart TV facing a comfortable sofa, and four new armchairs with clean, modern lines. French doors open to a spacious balcony with outdoor dining tables and chairs where guests can celebrate sunset and enjoy dinner under the stars. A primary bedroom off the living area has a sleek modern king bed, two comfortable armchairs, a private bathroom with a soaking tub, a separate shower, and access to the balcony.Located in the very heart of WaterColor, guests can walk to the Beach Club, restaurants and shopping in less than a minute, or explore nearby Seaside and Grayton Beach on 3 included adult bikes.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyLiving Area: Queen Murphy Pulldown Bed and Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyDisclaimer: All Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart is allowed per home. 360 Blue does not provide extension cords for charging. Please discuss charging needs directly with your rental company.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
